type F<T> = T extends unknown[] ? T : [];
type G<T> = [1, ...F<T>];
const g: G<[2]> = [1, 2];
type Rev<T extends unknown[]> = T extends [infer H, ...infer R] ? [...Rev<R>, H] : [];
const r: Rev<[1, 2, 3]> = [3, 2, 1];
type LL<T> = T extends [infer H, ...infer R] ? [H, ...LL<R>] : [];
const ll: LL<[1, 2]> = [1, 2];
type Tail<T> = T extends [unknown, ...infer R] ? R : never;
const t: Tail<[1, 2, 3]> = [2, 3];
console.log(g, r, ll, t);
